messages:
rachel: opened a small PR to clarify SOC2-friendly wording for the evidence export CLI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912

tom: nice. what's the recommended default for customers who just want activity logs but not PII?
rachel: default exports are anonymized. added a note and an example using --anonymize.

nisha: prefer naming the flag --user-identifiers for full exports instead of --identifiers. also add a sentence that full exports require a legal request + audit entry.

tom: can we include a one-line caution that anonymized exports remove stable correlation ids and may break forensic joins?

rachel: added that note and two runnable snippets:
```bash
# anonymized (default)
redwood export-evidence --since 2024-06-01 --until 2024-06-30 --format jsonl --anonymize

# full export (legal approval required)
redwood export-evidence --since 2024-06-01 --format jsonl --user-identifiers --auth-token $TOKEN
```

nisha: wording nit: use "are redacted by default" instead of "will be redacted". keeps tense clear.

legal-bot: reminder: docs describing access to user-identifiers must be routed to @legal-team for review. tagging now.

docs-ci: link-check and snippet linting passed :white_check_mark: 

link-bot: internal link to legal playbook flagged as internal-only :warning: (ok in internal docs; mark as "internal: do not publish" for public site).

tom: added a short line about TTLs: "Exports respect tenant retention settings; full exports for older data require legal hold."

rachel: thanks — I'll request legal sign-off and then merge and add a changelog entry.

nisha: local run of the snippets worked. LGTM pending legal.

legal-bot: queued for review, ETA ~48h.
